description: USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE [FACTORY OF] ACTIVE-CLASS (ISO §2023:13.18.60.2 general format, GR22 e)) — the reference is bound to "the same class as the object that was used to invoke the method in which this data description entry is specified". LIVE since kb/Work PB389: the descriptor carries the ACTIVE-CLASS kind and its containing class, the item emits that class's C# type, §2023:13.18.60.3 SR16 places it (COBOL1924), and §2023:14.9.39.3 SR12 b) / SR14 adjudicate it as a SET operand. ACTIVE-CLASS is a §2023:8.9 reserved word 2002+ and an ordinary user word at 85, so the token rides the cobolWord reservation funnel. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 USAGE clause's general format (§1985:VI.5.14.2) is `[ USAGE IS ] { BINARY | COMPUTATIONAL | COMP | DISPLAY | INDEX | PACKED-DECIMAL }` and nothing else, its §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR3 naming the numeric usages it has: 'a USAGE clause specifying BINARY, COMPUTATIONAL, or PACKED-DECIMAL must be declared with a PICTURE character-string that describes a numeric item', with no OBJECT REFERENCE alternative; §2002:13.16.58.1 prints `OBJECT REFERENCE [ interface-name-1 | [ FACTORY OF ] ACTIVE-CLASS | [ FACTORY OF ] class-name-1 [ ONLY ] ]`, §2002:F.1 item 6 lists ACTIVE-CLASS, FACTORY and OBJECT-REFERENCE among 'The following reserved words have been added', and §2002:F.2 item 82 states the change: 'Object orientation. Support for object oriented programming has been added.' §2002:13.16.58.3 GR14e has the phrase's meaning: 'If ACTIVE-CLASS is specified, the object referenced by this data item shall be of the same class as the object that was used to invoke the method in which this data description entry is specified', and §2002:13.16.58.2 SR15 its placement: 'The ACTIVE-CLASS phrase may be specified only in a factory definition, an instance definition, or the linkage or local-storage section of a method definition.' §2014:13.18.60.3 GR21e and §2014:13.18.60.2 SR16 carry both unchanged, so 2014 = 2023.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. UORAC.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM UORAC.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
CLASS-ID. UORACC.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
OBJECT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
METHOD-ID. MK.
DATA DIVISION.
LOCAL-STORAGE SECTION.
01 A USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE ACTIVE-CLASS.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET A TO SELF.
END METHOD MK.
END OBJECT.
END CLASS UORACC.
